annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于在超大特大城市积极稳步推进城中村改造的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Actively and Steadily Promoting Urban Village Renovation in Megacities and Super-Large Cities
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.venue: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府 (gov.cn)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office guidance (Guobanfa [2023] No. 25) on renovating urban villages in megacities: three renovation modes, expropriation rules, villager rights, funding balance, affordable housing integration, and local responsibility. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Classify urban villages into demolition-rebuild, upgrading, or mixed renovation
City governments bear primary responsibility; provincial governments supervise
Renovation requires consent of most villagers and lawful expropriation
Funds balanced within the city, with central subsidies, special bonds and bank loans
Renovated plots must include a share of affordable housing
